sources.name: Met Office
sources.notes: UK national meteorological service. Hourly forecasts and rain radar. Preferred for circuit-local forecasts on race/track-day mornings.

sources.name: BBC Weather
sources.notes: Uses Met Office data; accessible consumer interface. Good for quick circuit-postcode lookups.

sources.name: Windguru
sources.notes: Popular with track day riders for wind strength and gusts; useful at exposed circuits like Thruxton, Anglesey (coastal) and Knockhill.

sources.name: XCWeather
sources.notes: UK-specific hourly wind and rain forecast; popular with riders for circuit planning.

notes: UK weather changes rapidly — check forecast morning of event, not day before. Anglesey (coastal) and Knockhill (exposed hillside) particularly susceptible to unexpected wind and rain. Track surface temperature matters: cold Tarmac (<10°C) requires extended warm-up; slick tyres unsuitable below ~20°C ambient.
